spans.s:
mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यत्)
1 Other, different.
2 Unlike.
E.
अन to live, and यक् aff.

ind.
Otherwise.
E.
See the last.

Adulterous.
2

Going to another (place, &c.)
E.
अन्य another (husband or wife), गामिन् who goes to.

ind.
1 Again, moreover.
2 On the contrary.
E.
अन्यत्, and च and.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born of another (family, &c.) of a different origin.
E.
अन्य, and ज born.

n. (-न्म)
Another birth, being born again, the metempsychosis.
E.
अन्य, and जन्मन् birth.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मत्)
1 Either, any, any one of many.
2 Different, distinct from many.
E.
अन्य, and डतम aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रत्)
1 Other, different.
2 Either of two.
E.
अन्य other, and डतर affix; applied to words that refer to but two things.

ind.
Either of two days.
E.
अन्यतर, and एद्युस् affix, derived from द्युस् a day.

ind.
Elsewhere.
E.
अन्य, and तसि aff.

ind.
1 Elsewhere, in another place.
2 Except, unless, without.
E.
अन्य, and त्रल् aff.

ind.
1 Otherwise, in a different manner.
2 Inaccurately, untruly.
3 Badly.
E.
अन्य, and थाल् affix, referring to manner.

f. (तिः)
Erroneous conception of spirit.
E.
अन्यथा and ख्याति declaring.

n. (-त्वं)
An opposite or different state of the case.
E.
अन्यथा and त्व aff.

f. (-द्धिः)
Disproving a cause or argument, by giving it a different effect or application, coming to a different conclusion from the same premises.
E.
अन्यथा otherwise, and सिद्ध्रि proving, establishing.

ind.
Another time.
E.
अन्य, and दा affix, referring to time.

m. (-ष्टः)
The koil or Indian cuckoo, supposed to be reared by the crow.
E.
अन्य, and पुष्ट nourished.

f. (-र्व्वा)
A girl previously promised or betrothed to one and married to another.
E.
अन्य, and पूर्व्व prior.

m. (-त्)
A crow.
E.
अन्य another, and भृत् who nourishes: the crow is supposed to sit upon the eggs of the kokila: from भृ root, and क्विप् aff.

m. (-तः)
The kokila or Indian cuckoo.
E.
अन्य, and भृत nourished, from भृ with part. affix क्त; this bird, like the [] English cuckoo, being supposed to leave its eggs in the nests of other birds.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
1 Fickle-minded.
2 Absent.
E.
अन्य, and मनस् the mind.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
1 Absent, thinking of something else.
2 Fickle, versatile.
E.
अन्य, and मनस्क minded.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Fickle-minded, otherwise minded.
E.
अन्य, and मानस mental.

mfn. (-सः-ता-सं)
Brought up by a stranger, fostered.
E.
अन्य, and वर्द्धित part. past. of वृध् to grow.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Speaking inconsistently; (in law) prevaricating or a prevaricator.
E.
अन्य otherwise, and वादिन् who speaks.

m. (-खः)
An apostate.
E.
अन्य another, शाखा a branch or sect, or with कन् affix अन्यशाखकः.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Of another kind, like another.
E.
अन्य, दृश to see, and क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, with कञ् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Subject to others, dependant.
E.
अन्य, and अधीन dependant.

m. (-यः)
1 Impropriety, indecorum.
2 Irregularity, disorder.
E.
अ neg. न्याय propriety.

mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं)
Improper, indecorous, unbecoming, unfit.
E.
अ neg. न्याय्य right.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Unjust, unreasonable.
2

Indecorous.
3

Illogical.
E.
अ neg. न्यायिन्.

mfn. (-त्त-त्ता-त्तं)
Following evil courses.
E.
अन्याय improper, ष्टत्त practising.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Absent, intent on something else.
E.
अन्य, and आसक्त intent on.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Complete, entire.
E.
अ neg. and न्यून defective.

ind.
Another day.
E.
अन्य, and एद्युस् affix, from द्युस् a day.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Daily, diurnal, occurring every other day.
m. (-स्कः)
A quotidian fever.
E.
अन्येद्युस् and कत् added.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Begotten by another, the progeny of another than the reputed parent or husband.
E.
अन्य, and उत्पन्न born.

m. (-र्य्यः)
A stepmother's son.
E.
अन्य, and उदर belly, यञ् aff.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Mutual.
E.
अन्य repeated.

m. (-हः)
Mutual quarrel.
E.
अन्योन्य, and कलह strife.

m. (-तः)
Mutual conflict, striking, wounding or killing one another.
E.
अन्योन्य, and घात striking.

m. (-दः)
Mutual aversion or enmity.
E.
अन्योन्य, and भद difference.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taken or secreted from one another, taken severally.
E.
अन्योन्य, and अपहृत removed.

m. (-वः)
Mutual negation, relative difference.
E.
अन्योन्य, and अभाव non-existence.

m. (यः)
Mutual or reciprocal connexion or dependance.
E.
अन्योन्य, and आश्रय support.
